name: wintech-digital-partner
description: WinTech Digital Partner Full Stack Application (React.js + Node.js Express + TiDB)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true});"
